thread:
sam: Proposal: Marlin dedicated cutover Thurs 2026-05-02 01:30-03:30 UTC. Goal: migrate Marlin slice to new runtime image with improved batching. Need SRE/QA/Product + infra thumbs. Draft runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/marlin-cutover (internal).

deploybot: preflight started. ticket: RB-1184. checks: infra-ok, capacity-reserve-ok, kms-keys-ok, kvcache_priming: PENDING, release-notes: pending link.

kate-qa: I can do priming and the three smoke prompts. Plan: 50 synthetic requests/tenant, 5 min run. schedule at 01:40?

eng-ian: Model pin: redwood/inference:v2026-05-02-rc1 (contains kernel updates). Fallback: redwood/inference:v2026-04-01-int8. Canary plan: 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 15m holds on first two gates and 25m on 60%. Rollback triggers: p95 > 420ms OR 5xx rate > 0.8% sustained 3m.

sre-zoe: Note Marlin's latency SLO is p95 < 380ms. Ian's rollback numbers give small headroom; ok but we'll keep tight watch. Also confirm priming scope (slice-only?).

kate-qa: Priming slice-only. running at 01:42 UTC.

deploybot: release-notes link required by product.

product-lee: Added notes: https://go/internal/release-notes/marlin-2026-05-02. Includes changed API header behavior; PM will notify customer.

infra-matt: KMS key rotation scheduled 2026-05-01 23:00 UTC — no overlap. backing storage maintenance cleared.

kate-qa: priming done 01:47 UTC — 50 requests, no errors, avg latency 38ms, KV hit rate 92%.

sam: locking window. go/no-go at 01:10 UTC. If no objections, deploybot run at 01:30 UTC.

deploybot: job created deploy/4123456789-marlin. prometheus alerts attached: marlin_p95, marlin_errors. pager: @sre-team.

deploybot: event: canary_started @ 01:35 UTC (3% traffic).

eng-ian: first 10m looks stable. no visible 5xx. proceed to 20%.

deploybot: event: canary_ramp 20% @ 01:55 UTC.

sre-zoe: monitoring at +6m after 20% ramp: p95 climbed to 460ms for a few intervals, 5xx flat. rolling 3-min window shows p95 breach.

eng-ian: hmm. spike is in long-tail generation requests for long contexts. Could be kernel path in rc1. Recommend pause rollout and shift 20% traffic to fallback variant for 30m while we triage.

sam: Agreed. Pause and divert. ops: please enact traffic fallback.

deploybot: action: divert_traffic_to_fallback @ 02:03 UTC. 20% traffic now served by redwood/inference:v2026-04-01-int8.

product-lee: Notifying Marlin PM about temporary degradation investigation and fallback.

sre-zoe: After divert, p95 returned to ~360ms. We'll keep diverted for 30m. Alerting channel open for triage.

kate-qa: re-running smoke prompts against rc1 to reproduce locally. I see heavy tail on prompt #2. Sending logs to eng-ian.

eng-ian: Confirmed reproduction in staging with long-context sequences that trigger new kernel path. Plan: revert to stable image for now and schedule a patch release after kernel fix. Two options: (A) full rollback to previous stable across all traffic, or (B) maintain fallback for 20% and resume remainder to rc1 after fix. I recommend full rollback to reduce cognitive overhead for SRE and remove mixed-paths.

sre-zoe: I support full rollback. Mixed variants complicate tracing.

sam: Proceed with full rollback. Deploybot, run rollback to redwood/inference:v2026-04-01-int8 across Marlin slice.

deploybot: rollback_start @ 02:18 UTC. target image: redwood/inference:v2026-04-01-int8.

infra-matt: backup traffic policy enabled (shared-hosted fallback) as contingency.

deploybot: rollback_complete @ 02:26 UTC. status: success. metrics: p95 back to ~350ms, 5xx normal. artifacts: https://go/internal/deploys/4123456789/logs.

product-lee: PM acknowledged. They've asked for timeline for next attempt.

kate-qa: QA validated rollback behavior. No residual KVCACHE issues noted.

eng-ian: Next steps: create RC1.1 with kernel guardrail on long-context path, run extended perf tests, schedule re-rollout earliest Wed 2026-05-06 quiet window. I'll open RFC and link to issue.

sam: Thanks team. I'll update runbook to mark this attempt and outcome. We'll run a postmortem doc next week.

sre-zoe: Recording SRE follow-up action: tune alert thresholds and add synthetic long-context test to preflight.

deploybot: job final status: rolled_back. ticket updated RB-1184.

sam: Closing this thread. Will re-open for the reschedule. Thanks everyone.
